### 💡 Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex: "I'm always frustrated when using AI agents on Windows because [x] tool still assumes standard Linux bash syntax."

### 🌟 Describe the Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of the feature or skill you want to add, optimized for Windows native orchestration.

### 🛠️ Alternative Approaches Considered
Describe any alternative solutions, packages, or workarounds you've tried.

### 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, or API links that help explain your feature request.
